Stock Entry - Stamp Serial Consumed Date
script:
# Stamps consumed date and the customer / project / installation links onto the
# serials involved in a stock entry.
#
# ERPNext often updates Serial No through direct database writes, which skip
# document hooks, so this runs from the Stock Entry side. Saving the Serial No
# triggers 'Serial No - Warranty Dates and Status', which recomputes the
# warranty and AMC dates.
#
# Material Issue is the consumption step, so only it stamps the consumed date.
# Material Transfer still carries the links, so serials moved to a site
# warehouse already know their customer before installation.

is_issue = doc.purpose == "Material Issue"
is_transfer = doc.purpose == "Material Transfer"

if is_issue or is_transfer:
    installation = doc.get("installation")
    project = doc.get("custom_projects") or doc.get("project")
    customer = None

    # Installation is the richest source - it carries both customer and project.
    if installation:
        row = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Installation", installation, ["customer", "project"], as_dict=True
        )
        if row:
            customer = row.get("customer")
            project = row.get("project") or project

    # Product Delivery covers the transfer leg, before an Installation exists.
    if not customer and doc.get("product_delivery"):
        row = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Product Delivery", doc.product_delivery, ["customer", "project"], as_dict=True
        )
        if row:
            customer = row.get("customer")
            project = row.get("project") or project

    # Last resort - derive the customer from the project itself.
    if not customer and project:
        customer = frappe.db.get_value("Project", project, "customer")

    for it in doc.items:
        serials = []

        bundle = it.get("serial_and_batch_bundle")
        if bundle:
            rows = frappe.get_all(
                "Serial and Batch Entry",
                filters={"parent": bundle},
                fields=["serial_no"]
            )
            serials = [r.serial_no for r in rows if r.serial_no]
        elif it.get("serial_no"):
            raw = it.serial_no.replace(",", "\n")
            serials = [s.strip() for s in raw.split("\n") if s.strip()]

        for sn in serials:
            if not frappe.db.exists("Serial No", sn):
                continue

            sn_doc = frappe.get_doc("Serial No", sn)
            changed = False

            # Existing values are never overwritten, so a later transfer cannot
            # reassign a serial that is already tied to a customer.
            if is_issue and not sn_doc.custom_consumed_date:
                sn_doc.custom_consumed_date = doc.posting_date
                changed = True

            if customer and not sn_doc.custom_customer:
                sn_doc.custom_customer = customer
                changed = True

            if project and not sn_doc.custom_project:
                sn_doc.custom_project = project
                changed = True

            if installation and not sn_doc.custom_installation:
                sn_doc.custom_installation = installation
                changed = True

            if changed:
                sn_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

script:
# Fill blank MNRE + location fields on Paper Work from the Lead (server-side safety net).
lead = doc.get("custom_lead")
if not lead and doc.customer:
    lead = frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.customer, "lead_name")
    if lead:
        doc.custom_lead = lead

if lead and frappe.db.exists("Lead", lead):
    d = frappe.db.get_value("Lead", lead, [
        "email_id", "custom_kseb_phone_number", "custom_consumer_no", "custom_current_bill",
        "custom_current_bill_image", "custom_latitude", "custom_longitude",
        "custom_location_name", "custom_address", "city", "state",
    ], as_dict=True) or {}
    addr = d.get("custom_address") or ", ".join([x for x in [d.get("city"), d.get("state")] if x])
    pairs = [
        ["custom_consumer_no", d.get("custom_consumer_no")],
        ["custom_kseb_phone_number", d.get("custom_kseb_phone_number")],
        ["custom_email", d.get("email_id")],
        ["custom_address", addr],
        ["custom_current_bill", d.get("custom_current_bill")],
        ["custom_current_bill_image", d.get("custom_current_bill_image")],
        ["custom_latitude", d.get("custom_latitude")],
        ["custom_longitude", d.get("custom_longitude")],
        ["custom_location_name", d.get("custom_location_name")],
    ]
    for p in pairs:
        if p[1] and not doc.get(p[0]):
            doc.set(p[0], p[1])

script:
total = 0
for row in doc.package_items:
    qty = frappe.utils.flt(row.qty)
    rate = frappe.utils.flt(row.rate)
    disc = frappe.utils.flt(row.discount_amount)
    if disc > rate:
        frappe.throw(f"Row {row.idx}: Discount ({disc}) cannot be more than Rate ({rate})")
    row.amount = qty * (rate - disc)
    total = total + row.amount

doc.no_of_items = len(doc.package_items)
doc.total_amount = total
package_discount = frappe.utils.flt(doc.package_discount)
if package_discount > total:
    frappe.throw("Package Discount cannot be more than Total Item Amount")
doc.net_package_amount = total - package_discount
